text.en:
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 389 April 17, 1972
AMENDING EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 281 DATED DECEMBER 29, 1970, CREATING THE
PRESIDENTIAL COMMISSION TO REVIEW AND REVISE THE REORGANIZATION PLAN
Executive Order No. 281, dated December 29, 1970, creating the Presidential Commission to Review and
Revise the Reorganization Plan is hereby amended so as to designate Senator Ernesto M. Maceda as member
of the Commission vice Senator Salvador H. Laurel.
Done in the City of Manila, this 17th day of April, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-two.
